parameters.name: created_at_min
parameters.description: Required. Earliest order creation date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be before the tenant's inventory start date.

parameters.name: created_at_max
parameters.description: Optional. Latest order creation date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to inventory start date - 1 day.

parameters.name: parent_order_status
parameters.description: Optional. Filter by Temu parentOrderStatus: 1=Pending, 2=Un-shipping, 3=Shipped, 4=Partially Shipped, 5=Delivered, 6=Partially Delivered, 7=Cancelled, or 'any'.
